entries.zh: 夫人；太太（对妇人的尊称；本条接「母亲」(madre) 义项）
entries.en: madam; lady — "señora madre", honorific address to a (noble) mother
entries.notes: M 栏「luy tong」仅第二音节与字栏「堂」对应，首音节对应字缺；音标 T99 污損，故降置信。

entries.zh: 奶奶（对贵妇、官绅家妇人的尊称）
entries.en: noble lady; madam ("nainai", honorific for a lady of rank)

entries.notes: L/H 互证坐义明确；M 栏后段「che-ncui」未详，音标多处 T99，故降置信。

entries.zh: 坐（承接词条）；〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to sit (continuation entry); [text damaged, gloss uncertain]
entries.notes: 字栏「眉」与音写 mun 不相应（疑非同一词），音标 T99，故立义存疑。

entries.zh: 叉腿伸脚而坐；懒散斜坐
entries.en: to sit sprawling with legs stretched out; to loll
entries.notes: 西栏 repantigadamente（伸腿懒坐）义明确；字栏「堅脚獅」与音写 kia-ka-sai 仅「脚」相合，余字未详；音标 T99。

entries.en: to squat; to sit on one's haunches
entries.notes: L/H/M 互证蹲坐义（屈…坐，khut-té-tsē）；音标 T99，故降置信。
字栏「坐端正」与音写互证明确，仅因音标 T99 降置信。

entries.zh: 坐（承接词条；或指坐处、坐下歇留，动词／名词归属未定）
entries.en: to sit (continuation entry; possibly "a seat / sitting place")
entries.notes: 字栏「處坐」与音写 the-tse 或为「坐處」（座位）之倒序，义项难定；音标 T99。

entries.zh: 坐朝；帝王临朝御坐听政
entries.en: to sit in court, of a king on his throne; to hold court
to sit in the place of honor (the "big seat")
entries.notes: L/H/M 互证明确；音标一处 T99，按例降置信。

entries.zh: 暂住；暂且小住、稍坐等候
entries.en: to stay a while; to tarry briefly (sit and wait)
entries.notes: 字栏「暫住」与西栏「暂坐稍候」互证；M 栏「chu」上标鼻音符号（⁼/ⁿ）存疑。

entries.en: to sit facing each other; to sit aside/to one side

entries.zh: 席地而坐（如孩童般暂坐地上片刻）
entries.en: to sit on the ground for a while, as children do
entries.notes: 字栏首字存疑（罜/里）、音写起音存疑（t/f），仅「土」与西栏可立义；音标 T99。

entries.zh: 跌坐；猛然坐下（任身坠落）
entries.en: to plump/drop down into a seat, letting oneself fall
entries.notes: 西栏与字栏「…落地」可立跌坐义；首字存疑（碩/頭）、音写首音节未详；音标 T99。

entries.zh: 问；问案审讯；判罪（sentencia 判决）
entries.en: to ask, interrogate; a sentence/judgment, to pass sentence

entries.zh: 要；要旨要义（通行的教义、公论）
entries.en: the essential point; a common doctrine, received maxim

entries.notes: M 栏首音节存疑（t/f），余栏互证「大要」义。

entries.en: to interrogate; to judge, pass sentence
entries.notes: R 栏官话对音「giong chung」未能与字栏「問」对应，留待核查；L/H/M 互证问／判义明确。

entries.en: to decide, judge; to pass sentence
